policy.grid: Masks: native1920x1080, nearest-neighbor to output1024x576 for statistics. RGB reference: same phase1 INTER_LINEAR display RGB, not bokeh GT.
policy.head_high_side: Approved selected mask intersect q/255 > same-frame neck reference, combined high-side support; a head proxy, not anatomical truth. Empty on21-24: report N/A.
policy.low_side: Every8-connected component of approved selected low-side support separately; frame-local component IDs, no cross-component or cross-region averaging; no extra size filtering.
policy.neck: Original approved reference mask; invalid21 remains empty, no repair.
policy.body: Existing five input-RGB body_core anchor boxes, nearest anchor independent RGB NCC propagation using phase1 tracking thresholds; intersect original union and remove selection. Failed localization: N/A.
policy.head_context: Supplementary input-only diagnostic rectangle from nearest existing head_context anchor translated by original union bounding-box top-left displacement. All25 frames; includes neck/background, not pure-head or tracked material-point truth. Used for skipped-frame and temporal checks.
policy.water_near: Prior frame0 [745,170,35,30] translated by original union bounding-box displacement from frame0, intersect background. Sampling window follows subject, not tracked water material.
policy.MAE: Mean abs RGB8 difference vs input RGB on each exact region; empty regions N/A.
policy.gradient_energy_ratio: Sobel3x3 on full-image grayscale(.299,.587,.114), RGB normalized0-1; mean(gx^2+gy^2) on3x3-eroded region, divided by corresponding input energy. Empty gradient support or input energy<=1e-15: N/A. No mask-induced artificial edges; not a bokeh quality score or directly identical to historical rectangle-crop metric.
policy.temporal: 18->19,19->20,20->21,21->22,22->23: fixed image-coordinate union of each pair's supplementary head-context rectangles. Report per-method RGB8 temporal MAE, input-relative temporal-change residual and R-minus-A temporal response, plus A-repeat noise. No motion compensation; call region change, not flicker.
policy.repeat: Actually compare float32 uint32 bit patterns and RGB8 bytes; if nonidentical retain quantified repeat noise, no automatic quality judgement.
